blocks.text: This chapter traces David’s family and the royal line that follows through Solomon. Within the larger sequence of genealogies and registers in 1 Chronicles 1–9, it is part of a selective presentation linking the restored community with Adam, Israel’s tribes, David, priests, Levites, and preexilic Jerusalem.

The genealogies surrounding this chapter are best read as selective literary maps of kinship, land, office, and restored identity, rather than as exhaustive modern-style biological pedigrees. Gaps, parallel lines, differing names, and compressed generations therefore need to be considered case by case.
